name: hero-video
description: The hero video on the pyocr-toolkit website

scripts.figures: mkdir -p public/tours && cp ../docs/tours/*-dark.png public/tours/ && cp ../docs/logo.svg public/
scripts.render: npm run figures && remotion render HeroDemo ../docs/media/hero-demo.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=30 --x264-preset=slower && remotion still HeroDemo ../docs/media/hero-poster.webp --frame=-1
